Aligning available inventory at sources with required quantities at destinations—while considering route-by-route shipping costs—is essential to protect margins and service.

Problem:

- Use these inputs to produce a recommended plan that assigns shipment quantities to each source–destination lane, ensuring all needs are met without exceeding availability.

- Improves service reliability by ensuring every destination is fully supplied.
- Minimizes expedites and last-minute rebalancing by proactively aligning supply and demand.

```python
from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    m = Model("Transportation_Problem")
    m.setParam("TimeLimit", 300)  # Set time limit to 300 seconds

    # Data
    sources = list(range(7))  # S0..S6
    destinations = list(range(6))  # D0..D5

    supplies = [94, 47, 50, 55, 67, 37, 69]
    demands = [14, 47, 21, 70, 72, 58]

    # Cost matrix: rows correspond to sources S0..S6, columns to destinations D0..D5
    costs = [
        [ 12.02,   7.06,  16.65,  18.43,  14.67,   8.11],  # S0
        [ 23.82,  25.36,  18.15,  24.40,   5.59,  28.53],  # S1
        [ 23.97,  24.46,   7.90,  18.60,  26.82,   7.64],  # S2
        [ 12.12,  15.71,  26.28,  18.18,  23.66,  22.78],  # S3
        [ 24.61,  19.52,   5.23,  16.70,  13.98,  10.76],  # S4
        [ 10.46,  27.17,  16.21,  15.54,   6.49,   6.83],  # S5
        [  9.72,  22.59,  18.27,   9.91,  21.22,  24.25],  # S6
    ]

    # Decision variables:
    # Flow_S{i}_D{j} >= 0 is the quantity shipped from source i to destination j
    flows = {}
    for i in sources:
        for j in destinations:
            flows[(i, j)] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Flow_S{i}_D{j}")

    # Objective: Minimize total transportation cost
    m.setObjective(
        quicksum(costs[i][j] * flows[(i, j)] for i in sources for j in destinations),
        GRB.MINIMIZE
    )

    # Supply constraints: Shipments from each source <= its supply
    for i in sources:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(flows[(i, j)] for j in destinations) <= supplies[i],
            name=f"Supply_S{i}"
        )

    # Demand constraints: Shipments to each destination >= its demand
    for j in destinations:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(flows[(i, j)] for i in sources) >= demands[j],
            name=f"Demand_D{j}"
        )

    m.optimize()
    return m
```
